announcements.title: CKY 25th Anniversary competitions
announcements.body:
Hi everyone,
As you know, the CKY 25th Anniversary celebrations start next week, and the English department is running two competitions, one for you and one for your parents. Please read the information below carefully, and if you would like to take part in either of the competitions, please follow the instructions.
Best of luck!
Mr. Ghomrassi
CKY 25th Anniversary competitions - Parent competition
1. What is the competition about?
a. In 2025, Po Leung Kuk Choi Kai Yau School celebrated its 25th anniversary. To commemorate this occasion, the school's English department is organising a writing competition for parents. We invite parents to submit a piece of writing which answers the question: "How has CKY's 25 years of education influenced and shaped your family?" Parents are invited to submit a short piece of writing (maximum 250 words) sharing their reflections on the school's impact on their family. Entries will be judged on quality and creativity, and the top three winners will receive a prize.
b. Please use the link below to access the form to upload your writing.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfr3Cck8c0J1u8mZ5k8dM-8mE1fW9K2d7Xj5h4bPq5hPqZ5hPqZ5hPqZ5/viewform?usp=header
c. The deadline for this competition is Monday 7th December 2026.
d. Please make sure that you have saved the form before you submit it. The link will be sent to you via a school notice.
2. What is the prize?
a. The prize is a 1st Prize Certificate and a book voucher.
CKY 25th Anniversary competitions - Student competition

a. In 2025, Po Leung Kuk Choi Kai Yau School celebrated its 25th anniversary. To commemorate this occasion, the school's English department is organising a writing competition for students. Entries will be judged on quality and creativity, and the top three winners will receive a prize.
